consent.bannerText: {site}, as data fiduciary, uses essential cookies to run this seller portal. With your permission we also use analytics cookies to measure how long onboarding takes and marketing cookies to remember the referral link you came from. Nothing optional is used unless you accept. Choose Customise to see every cookie. <link>Cookie policy</link>
consent.dialogIntro: Choose which optional cookies and similar storage {site} may use. Essential ones are always on because the site cannot work without them. You can change your choice at any time from Cookie settings in the footer.
consent.gpcNote: Your browser's Global Privacy Control signal is on, so marketing stays off unless you switch it on here.
consent.necessaryDesc: Needed for sign-in, security, your language and your onboarding progress, and to remember this choice. They cannot be switched off.
consent.analyticsDesc: Records when you created your business, only to measure how long onboarding takes (time to your first listing and to finishing). Nothing else, and nothing is shared with other companies.
consent.marketingDesc: Remembers the referral code from the link you followed (for example from another seller), so the person who referred you can be credited when you create your business.

purpose.consentPending: Holds your latest cookie choice until our server confirms it has saved the record of it.
purpose.auth: Keeps you signed in for a few minutes at a time (short-lived access token).
purpose.session: Keeps you signed in on this device (refresh token, revoked when you sign out).
purpose.oauth: Protects the Google sign-in round trip against forgery.
purpose.mfa: Holds a pending two-step sign-in for a few minutes.
purpose.onboardingSkip: Remembers an onboarding step you chose to skip.
purpose.onboardingStart: Records when you created your business, to measure how long onboarding takes.
purpose.onboardingFirstListing: Remembers that you submitted your first listing, so onboarding can show you the result.
purpose.referral: Remembers the referral code from the link you followed until you create your business.
purpose.consentSync: Remembers, for this visit only, that your cookie choice was checked against your account.

consent.policyDescription: Which cookies and similar storage {site} uses, why, for how long, and how to change your choice.
consent.whatBody: Cookies are small text files a website saves in your browser. We also use similar browser storage (local and session storage). Some are essential; the rest are used only if you agree.
consent.categoriesBody: We group them into three categories. Essential ones are always on. Analytics and marketing are off until you accept them, and refusing them never limits what you can do on {site}.
consent.changeBody: You can change your choice at any time; withdrawing is as easy as giving consent. When you withdraw, we stop that use and delete the related cookies and storage.
consent.gpcBody: If your browser sends the Global Privacy Control signal, we treat marketing as switched off by default. You can still switch it on yourself in the preferences.
consent.grievanceBody: Contact our Grievance Officer if you have a question or complaint about how we use cookies or your personal data.
